message: "users"."name" is dropped and re-added in the same migration. Every existing value in this column will be lost.
why: TypeORM drops and re-adds a column when its type or length changes, instead of changing it in place. The new column starts empty.
safeAlternative: Change the type in place: ALTER TABLE "users" ALTER COLUMN "name" TYPE varchar(255). Widening a varchar, or changing varchar to text, does not rewrite the table. For other type changes, add a new column, backfill it, switch the code, and drop the old column in a later release.
